payload.name: OpenERP — CI regression fix (D9 + deps)
payload.goal: Corriger les 2 régressions CI sur main (pg integration smoke cassé par D9 7efdf1c: Date vs string dans match.ts; web e2e cassé par b2d9078: esbuild.target retiré) puis publier main avec CI verte.

payload.note: Both CI regressions fixed and pushed as bf95525. Root causes: (1) pg returns Date for timestamptz/date but matcher+domain types expect ISO strings -> formatted all D9 temporal columns as UTC ISO in SQL; (2) Playwright webServer runs vite dev which uses esbuild target not build.target -> restored esbuild+optimizeDeps targets at es2022. Conductor reverted an out-of-scope journal-entries.ts change by the implementer. Verified locally against CI-equivalent postgres:16 container and real chromium: api 1660/1660 (integration no longer skipped), e2e 218 passed/1 skipped, worker 55/55, lints+checks green. Awaiting GitHub CI confirmation.

DONE. bf95525 pushed; GitHub CI confirms pg integration smoke = success and web e2e = success (both were failing). Remaining red check Deploy to dev is infra-only (tenant-quota cpu 1400m/1500m saturated + node capacity/taint), predates my commits, escalated to poc-k8s via h2a. Superseded Dependabot PR #7 closed.
